notes_for_editor: Thin record: the only history is a 1950 newspaper item (quoted on Forest Lookouts) and the 2008 report. The 1950 item calls the tower newly built, so 1950 is a build-by date, not a confirmed build year; the brief has no build date. The Press Herald spells the name Peek-a-Boo. Height, design, staffing and fate beyond standing were not found. FFLA list shows no cab asterisk, which the legend says means the cab is gone when marked; treated as cab still present. Brief access 'unknown': only 'popular hiking destination' was found, so access level public is an inference; check the land owner. Search returned no further history. firelookout.org/lookouts/me/me.htm returned 404; Maine Atlas fire-tower page had no Peekaboo entry. Brief 2008 restoration event is supported by the report; brief wording 'paint still to come' is consistent.
